note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Two contests, Ballyreagh and Monea; the other divisions were returned unopposed and are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Completed 7 Nov 2026 (meetings-fermanagh1930) from the Fermanagh Times nominations report (8 May 1930, p. 8, read on the page image): 22 divisions returned unopposed, plus Tempo, where Lawrence Tubman's nomination fell away before the poll. Three members were co-opted at the first meeting (Fermanagh Times, 12 June 1930, p. 8): Thomas Smith, Laurence Tubman and Wm. Crawford (co-options, not election results). The Fermanagh Times prints him among the nominations ('Ballycassidy—Colonel Richardson, D.L.', 8 May 1930, p. 8); the Fermanagh Herald says no candidate was nominated and the seat went to him as the sitting member. Either way he was returned without a poll. Returned unopposed.
